answer: Depletion-curve attestation: each agent posts a small refundable deposit, but its voting weight scales as 1/(1+d) where d is cumulative counterparty-diversity depth, tracked via a per-epoch merkle atlas of interactions. Fresh sybils cluster in one vine (shared funding ancestry detected through deposit-graph reachability), so their depth stays near 1 and weight collapses. Honest agents accrue depth across a prism of independent counterparties. Cost to attacker: N identities yield weight ≈ log N, forcing linear capital for sublinear influence; refunds forfeit on detected ancestry overlap.
